meeting.title: ChowNow weekly sync — go-live prep
meeting.summary: Weekly sync with ChowNow ahead of go-live. Parity sign-off completed; Ines to run the restaurant success team training next Tuesday, Matthias to write the internal launch announcement.
action_items: Ines to run restaurant success team training next Tuesday
Matthias to write the internal launch announcement before training
key_decisions: Parity sign-off accepted — go-live proceeds as planned
meeting.notes: Restaurant-performance dashboards matched legacy numbers within tolerance. Legacy tool decommission timing intentionally left open.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Morning Matthias. Big week — how did the parity checks land?

transcript.speaker: Matthias Krüger
transcript.text: All green. We finished the parity sign-off on Friday — every orders dashboard matches the legacy numbers within tolerance, and I've signed the doc.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: That's the milestone. So go-live proceeds as planned.

transcript.speaker: Matthias Krüger
transcript.text: Yes. The remaining worry is people, not data. The restaurant success team barely touched the new tool.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Then let's fix that before launch. I'll run the restaurant success team training next Tuesday — ninety minutes, hands-on with their own dashboards.

transcript.speaker: Matthias Krüger
transcript.text: Tuesday works, most of them are in the LA office that day.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Good. It also helps if the launch is announced internally before the training, so people know why they're there.

transcript.speaker: Matthias Krüger
transcript.text: Agreed — I'll write the internal launch announcement and get it out before the training session.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Perfect. Anything on the legacy side?

transcript.speaker: Matthias Krüger
transcript.text: We'll probably want to turn off access to the old tool eventually, but we haven't decided when. Some teams still have bookmarked reports.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: No rush — most teams run both for a few weeks. Let's decide after launch.

transcript.speaker: Ines Ferreira
transcript.text: Recap then: parity signed off, training with me next Tuesday, announcement from you before that. See you at training.
